summary_en: Kanematsu's subsidiary Kanematsu Electronics will not tender its shares of Global Security Expert (GSX) in Accenture's public tender offer but will sell all GSX shares to GSX's self-share buyback after the tender closes, generating an estimated 14.5 billion yen gain in net income for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Expected Equity Method Investment Gain on Stock Sale in Connection with Public Tender Offer and Impact on Business Results
translation_en_brief: On October 27, 2026, Kanematsu Corporation's board of directors resolved to have its consolidated subsidiary Kanematsu Electronics enter into a non-tender agreement with Accenture Corporation regarding Global Security Expert (GSX), an affiliate accounted for using the equity method. Under the agreement, Kanematsu Electronics will not tender its GSX ordinary shares in Accenture's public tender offer but will sell all GSX shares to GSX's self-share repurchase program after the tender closes successfully. Kanematsu Electronics signed the non-tender agreement on October 30, 2026. The transaction is contingent on successful completion of Accenture's public tender offer. Upon completion, the sale of all GSX shares is expected to generate an equity method investment gain of approximately 14.5 billion yen in Kanematsu's consolidated net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company stated it undertook this transaction as part of its portfolio optimization and capital efficiency improvement initiatives to enhance corporate value. No specific information on the number of GSX shares held, the sale price, or the timing beyond "after tender offer closes" was disclosed. The fiscal 2027 earnings guidance does not currently incorporate this expected gain, and the company will revise its forecast if necessary.
